data.name: Durdanah
data.gender_notes: Durdanah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Durdanah is an Arabic name for girls, meaning 'bright light'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'durr', which means 'pearl' or 'jewel'. The name signifies the radiance and brilliance of a precious gem, and is often given to girls born during the spring season. The name Durdanah carries the meaning “Bright light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Durdanah usually hope their child will grow to embody bright light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Durdanah is believed to carry deep spiritual significance. It is said to represent the inner light of the soul, and is believed to bring joy, happiness, and prosperity to those who bear this name.
data.etymology: Durdanah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Durdanah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
